key: Stay safe out there, and come back as often as you need.
en: Stay safe out there, and come back as often as you need.
ja: 外では気をつけて。いつでも 戻っておいで

key: Ah, a survivor!
en: Ah, a survivor!
ja: おお 生き延びた者か!

key: Are you injured? I've gathered plenty of supplies here to last until this crisis is over.
en: Are you injured? I've gathered plenty of supplies here to last until this crisis is over.
ja: けがはないか? この危機が終わるまでもつだけの物資は 集めてある

key: I've no idea where the original owner of this abode has gone to, but I'm sure they won't mind if we recuperate here in their absence...
en: I've no idea where the original owner of this abode has gone to, but I'm sure they won't mind if we recuperate here in their absence...
ja: この家の元の持ち主が どこへ行ったかは知らんが 留守のあいだに休ませてもらっても 怒りはしまい……

key: Would you stay a while to rest?
en: Would you stay a while to rest?
ja: 少し 休んでいくかね?

key: Do be careful out there.
en: Do be careful out there.
ja: 外では くれぐれも 気をつけて

key: As you will.
en: As you will.
ja: 好きにしなさい

key: Come by any time!
en: Come by any time!
ja: いつでも 寄っておくれ!

key: I'm looking for a Sunkern.
en: I'm looking for a Sunkern.
ja: ヒマナッツを 探しているんだ

key: Greetings, wanderer.
en: Greetings, wanderer.
ja: やあ 旅の人

key: We don't get many visitors up here since it all went down.
en: We don't get many visitors up here since it all went down.
ja: あれ以来 ここに来る者は ほとんどいなくてね

key: Welcome to my humble home!
en: Welcome to my humble home!
ja: ようこそ わがボロ家へ!

key: It could use a bit of TLC...
en: It could use a bit of TLC...
ja: 少し 手入れが必要だがな……

key: But no one else was using this building so it's mine now, heh heh!
en: But no one else was using this building so it's mine now, heh heh!
ja: 誰も使っていなかったから 今はオレのものさ へへっ!

key: ...Ahem.
en: ...Ahem.
ja: ……ゴホン

key: Anyway, if I'm going to not starve to death out here, I'm going to need to start growing food soon.
en: Anyway, if I'm going to not starve to death out here, I'm going to need to start growing food soon.
ja: とにかく ここで飢え死にしたくないなら そろそろ食べ物を育てないとな

key: To that end, I'm looking for a Sunkern.
en: To that end, I'm looking for a Sunkern.
ja: そこで ヒマナッツを 探しているんだ

key: I'm very willing to trade one of my own prized Pokémon for it.
en: I'm very willing to trade one of my own prized Pokémon for it.
ja: 代わりに 自慢のポケモンを 一匹ゆずってもいいぞ

key: How about a Mime Jr.?
en: How about a Mime Jr.?
ja: マネネなんて どうだ?

key: I'll even throw in a free Exp. Share to sweeten the deal, if you'll have it.
en: I'll even throw in a free Exp. Share to sweeten the deal, if you'll have it.
ja: 受けてくれるなら おまけに がくしゅうそうちも タダでつけよう

key: Well, it's no matter. Good luck!
en: Well, it's no matter. Good luck!
ja: まあ 気にするな。がんばれよ!

key: You found one! Miraculous! Let's begin straightaway!
en: You found one! Miraculous! Let's begin straightaway!
ja: 見つけたのか! 見事だ! さっそく始めよう!

key: \PN traded Sunkern for Mime Jr.!
en: \PN traded Sunkern for Mime Jr.!
ja: \PNは ヒマナッツと マネネを 交換した!

en: Beauteous! My heart goes out to you, kid!
ja: すばらしい! 心から 感謝するぞ 若いの!

key: The item you'll find attached is just a little bonus from me!
en: The item you'll find attached is just a little bonus from me!
ja: 持たせてあるどうぐは オレからの ちょっとしたおまけだ!

key: You'll find it's a little more potent than other regions' versions too!
en: You'll find it's a little more potent than other regions' versions too!
ja: よその地方のものより 少しだけ強力なはずだぞ!

key: How about a Cryogonal?
en: How about a Cryogonal?
ja: フリージオなんて どうだ?

key: \PN traded Sunkern for Cryogonal!
en: \PN traded Sunkern for Cryogonal!
ja: \PNは ヒマナッツと フリージオを 交換した!

key: \PN traded Sunkern for Furfrou!

en: Just don't think too hard about how I'll actually be using the Sunkern.

key: Hello again.
en: Hello again.
ja: また会ったな

key: Oh, a Trainer.
en: Oh, a Trainer.
ja: おや トレーナーか

key: I'm surprised your type is still wandering about out here.
en: I'm surprised your type is still wandering about out here.
ja: お前のような手合いが まだこの辺をうろついているとはな

key: ...But you seem like the type to value and respect nature.
en: ...But you seem like the type to value and respect nature.
ja: ……だが 自然を敬い 大切にする性質のようだ

key: Well, I'll deign to do you a favor then.
en: Well, I'll deign to do you a favor then.
ja: では 一つ 恵んでやろう

key: If you have any Pokémon that would like to learn the move Giga Drain, I'll teach it to them free of charge.
en: If you have any Pokémon that would like to learn the move Giga Drain, I'll teach it to them free of charge.
ja: ギガドレインを覚えたいポケモンがいるなら タダで教えてやろう

key: Stay safe out there.
en: Stay safe out there.
ja: 外では 気をつけろよ

key: You're still here?
en: You're still here?
ja: まだ いたのか?

key: Be gone already.
en: Be gone already.
ja: もう 行け

key: Let nature heal.
en: Let nature heal.
ja: 自然を 回復させてやれ

key: But it's better if you don't, you know?
en: But it's better if you don't, you know?

key: You're all the same, and all part of the problem.
en: You're all the same, and all part of the problem.
ja: お前たちは みな同じだ。みな 問題の一部だ

en: So part of the city dips under-- haven't people taken enough?
ja: 街の一部が沈んだからといって——人はもう十分に奪ってきただろう?

key: Let it regrow on its own.
en: Let it regrow on its own.

key: I'll learn to live here with nature as we were always intended to.
en: I'll learn to live here with nature as we were always intended to.

key: Hey, this is private business! Stay out of it!

key: Grr...
en: Grr...

en: I give up. No one will even throw me a bone.

en: Ah, I'm saved! Thank you so much!

key: That Meteor had trapped me in here for so long!
en: That Meteor had trapped me in here for so long!

key: What could they be plotting?
en: What could they be plotting?
ja: いったい 何をたくらんでいるんだろう?

key: Regardless, I'll be heading back now! Good luck!
en: Regardless, I'll be heading back now! Good luck!
ja: ともかく もう帰るよ! 気をつけてな!

en: Yes
